pages.text: Two block tags, empty by default:$(br)$(thing)flowline:no_connect$(): pipes never connect to these blocks.$(br)$(thing)flowline:no_facade$(): these blocks cannot become facades.$(br2)Recipes are ordinary data pack recipes.
KubeJS needs no special support. For example:$(br2)ServerEvents.tags('block', e => {$(br)  e.add('flowline:no_connect', 'minecraft:chest')$(br)})
